propositions: No aggregated lens exists for closed bugs; trend analysis requires ad-hoc scripts instead of queryable metrics dimensions.
Close_class distribution must surface the pre-convention era (∼214 bugs lacking close_class) as an explicit MISSING labeled cohort, avoiding silent era mixing.

Flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close TRANSITION within the context range; stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, caused_by fan-in) are point-in-time measures over the current store and ignore the range.
Detected_by field is sparse (not yet populated in real store); the dimension must degrade to unavailable state without affecting other dimensions when the field is absent everywhere.
Edge case: zero bugs in store must report unavailable state per registry convention rather than crashing or returning empty-implies-healthy results.
